row: Owner MAS-bearer writes with optional same-owner enrolled-device signatures

homeModel.working: one encrypted, mounted, writable home bound to owner/agent/computer/disk
homeModel.recovery: sealed generations are immutable; the one platform placement record carries selectedGeneration and changes by placementRevision
homeModel.migration: one import key has one terminal generation; replay returns already_imported and never imports twice
homeModel.generationLineage: v1.x agent.commit generations and v2 sealed checkpoints are the same monotonic generation lineage; existing state is imported once, never renumbered into a parallel lineage

signing.admission: same pinned-key, commandId/nonce replay, owner/agent/computer binding and expiry rules as device-service/3

base.rule: minimal owner-authorization amendment; every 2.4 fixture remains byte-identical

placementAuthority.authorityLease: short executor term under home epoch
placementAuthority.revisionRule: checkpoints advance placementRevision and selectedGeneration; only authority-changing move commits advance homeEpoch
placementAuthority.activeMoveRule: a committed move is immutable history; placement.activeMove clears on commit, and a later epoch/revision may start a new move
placementAuthority.legacyReconciliation: the v2 placement record and import-once generation lineage remain canonical; this minor widens location and executor authentication
placementAuthority.messageAuthority: home.placement.update and home.mount.request remain cloud-controller-only; home.placement.record is the widened platform-owned portable authority

checkpointPolicy.pathRule: NFC Unicode relative paths with spaces are allowed; exact credential, key, browser-profile, database/sidecar and excluded-tree patterns are skipped before manifest construction
checkpointPolicy.skippedCaptureRule: capture records only category, reasonCode, count and pathSha256 for excluded paths; a manifest that lists an excluded path is invalid
checkpointPolicy.consistency: quiesce writers, SQLite backup, stable-file staging, upload verification, then current-epoch CAS

failoverPolicy.unreachableBasis: no recent platform-timestamped authenticated agent-service readiness covering home, runtime and Matrix intake
failoverPolicy.wakeRule: asleep_wakeable triggers one wake attempt bound to the current unreachableSincePlatform episode and an eligibility-sweep grace period before takeover

executorAuthentication.cloud: cloud_workload is admitted only on a cloud-held placement with the platform-pinned workload key

mac.binding: the active pinned key is bound to exactly one deviceServiceId and keyEpoch
mac.admission: signerKeyId must equal the active pinned key; the signature must verify; meta.deviceServiceId must equal placement.location.deviceServiceId
mac.rotation: the previous active pinned key signs the bounded rotation frame; previousKeyId equals signerKeyId; nextKeyEpoch increments exactly once; nextKeyId differs; the prior key is retired atomically
mac.expiry: every executor frame has expiresAt after issuedAt, at most two hours later, and is refused unless nowPlatform is before expiresAt
mac.renewal: every renewal issues a new leaseId; the presented expiry must exactly match the platform-trusted expiry

executorAuthentication.wakingRule: a waking home is quarantined until it reads placement and reacquires current authority

matrixPublication.serialization: publication admission and send are serialized against move commit

eraseSemantics.receiptCoverage: complete and pending_offline receipts report every requested location as erased or pending; complete coveredLocations equals the reported location set
eraseSemantics.restore: a tombstone refuses every operation and restore for its homeId regardless of a declared epoch; re-creating an agent allocates a new homeId; browser sessions excluded

browserSessionBoundary.portableCheckpoint: browser profiles, cookies and browser sessions remain excluded
browserSessionBoundary.retainedStore: separate encrypted retained-session store, outside portable checkpoints
browserSessionBoundary.restore: atum.cloud-execution/2.1 decides restored versus login_required, filters durable removed-site tombstones and preserves the idle clock
browserSessionBoundary.message: account restore emits browser session state only as browser.restore.record; restore.record carries no browser session state

unledgeredPublication.authority: the current home epoch, executor term, live lease, placement revision and pinned signer; the move drain closes new admission
unledgeredPublication.replayRule: an exact immutable replay against the active key returns the stored receipt, including after drain acknowledgement; any changed outbox, fence, placement revision, room, Matrix transaction, payload digest/size, event type, payload bytes or signer key conflicts
unledgeredPublication.epochReuseRule: only a refused row with no event from an older home epoch is idempotency-superseded; the current epoch may reuse its client key with a new outbox and transaction; queued, admitted, sending, published, uncertain and partial rows remain active across epochs and are never re-sent
unledgeredPublication.replayAdmissionRule: nonce, command, sequence or clock-window refusal occurs before supersession or insert and persists no outbox row
unledgeredPublication.worker: the existing fenced agent-home publication outbox and Matrix publisher

placementConnection.negotiation: owner.home.snapshot.moveCapability advertises exact profile 2.5 before Move is offered
placementConnection.ownerCas: request and cancel compare homeEpoch plus activeMove.moveId; placementRevision is not an owner CAS because checkpoints advance it
placementConnection.progressOrdering: sequence is monotonic per move; clients ignore a progress record whose sequence is lower than the highest seen

preflight.request: MAS-owner-authorized target, chosen model and catalog revision; surface must equal the authenticated channel; an optional desktop owner_client signature is verified when present
preflight.losses: sorted unique closed-code set recomputed by the platform at request and again immediately before commit
preflight.expiry: platform time only; nowPlatform >= expiresAtPlatform is expired
preflight.staleCatalog: a stale catalog may be displayed but cannot back a preflight
preflight.lossOrder: ascending Unicode code point order, unique

placementConnection.manualUnreachable: without acceptCheckpointLoss=true the move stays finishing_current_work until drain fails source_unreachable and the old home remains authoritative; with the exact loss and checkpoint time accepted, an explicit forced move may proceed
placementConnection.automaticTakeover: unchanged from D1: durable pending work plus the existing 15-minute unreachable rule; 2.4 adds no automatic trigger or destination
placementConnection.idempotency: scope is owner+agent+operation+idempotencyKey; exact retry replays, changed body conflicts, and a retry after failed uses a new key; the move request maps the owner key unchanged to home.move.request.idempotencyKey
placementConnection.manualConflict: a later manual move may supersede an uncommitted manual move; the losing phone or desktop observes failed/superseded
placementConnection.cancelAfterCommit: cancel at ready_to_commit or after commit returns committed_epoch_preserved

availabilityReasons.target_unavailable: preflight or pre-commit eligibility failed before authority changed
availabilityReasons.destination_unreachable: move committed, target remains authoritative, but it did not become serving

placementConnection.generationBinding: when a cloud placement is first materialized, selectedGeneration is the exact committed cloud HomeStore generation (not a synthetic genesis counter); every move-drain checkpoint then has parentGeneration equal to selectedGeneration, and its committed generation becomes both portable lineage.generation and move-commit selectedGeneration
placementConnection.catalogEpochBinding: outside a move every enrolled Mac publishes homeEpoch N with activeMoveId null; during a move only the target Mac publishes N+1 with that moveId, while every other Mac remains at N/null; catalog freshness gates preflight and move admission but elapsed wall time alone never aborts an admitted move whose exact revision, content and epoch binding still match
placementConnection.overrideClearing: conversationOverrideCount is frozen by accepted preflight; the participant clears that disclosed count before commit, but clearConversationOverrides is not a home.move.commit field and must not be added to the commit RPC body

cloudPortability.lineage: placementRevision is the revision after the move-drain checkpoint selected lineage.generation and before move commit; move commit consumes that revision and advances it once
cloudPortability.crossMessageEqualities: export, conversion, import, adapter receipts and move commit share moveId; conversion sourceArchiveSha256 equals export receipt; lineage.generation equals move commit selectedGeneration
cloudPortability.cloudOutputSealing: an import targeting cloud uses cloud_home_store_controller_workload
cloudPortability.recovery: abort before commit leaves the old home authoritative and resumable; after commit a returning stale source is quarantined by home.return.report and epoch fencing

modelApplication.preferenceWrite: owner.home.model-choice.write is authorized by the MAS owner bearer in 2.5; an optional owner_client signature is verified when present; atum.model-choice/1.3 remains the byte-frozen persistence predecessor
modelApplication.connectionRef: opaque random reference scoped to the bound owner/agent/device; never derived from an account identifier
modelApplication.reportCas: homeEpoch plus activeMoveId, exact stored choice, nondecreasing choiceRevision and catalogRevision
modelApplication.unavailablePolicy: for any pending or unavailable Mac projection, turns are held and the billing source never changes to Atum
modelApplication.nextTurn: application occurs only at the next turn boundary and never mutates an admitted or running turn
modelApplication.roomOverrides: all legacy per-conversation model overrides for the moved agent are cleared on commit; preflight discloses conversation_overrides_cleared when any exist; the home default applies afterward

cloudConnection.catalog: the existing managed model catalog and atum.model-choice/1.3 served offers

catalogRules.ingest: Mac-signed and exact-replay fenced; the Mac never assigns catalogRevision
catalogRules.receipt: the platform assigns catalogRevision; it increments only when connection/model contentSha256 changes, while a null-to-moveId republish of identical content keeps the revision
catalogRules.freshness: freshUntilPlatform is compared only with platform time; equality is stale; stale catalogs may display but may not back preflight

ownerWriteAuthorization.authority: the authenticated MAS bearer establishes the owner and native phone or desktop surface
ownerWriteAuthorization.signature: optional; if any owner_client signing field is present, the complete 2.4 signed metadata is required
ownerWriteAuthorization.signedAdmission: resolve signerKeyId through the owner's device-service registry, then verify the signature against that same owner's ACTIVE enrolled identity key using the inherited device-service/3 domain and bytes

signedRefusals.signature_expired: issuedAt/expiresAt is outside the inherited signed-message window
signedRefusals.bad_signature: the key is unknown, revoked, belongs to another owner, does not match signerKeyId, or the signature is invalid

ownerWriteAuthorization.replay: a retry of one logical owner operation reuses both requestId and the operation idempotency key; effect identity excludes signed or bearer metadata, so renewed authentication bytes cannot create a second effect; changing any effect field conflicts
ownerWriteAuthorization.deferredSafeguard: bind bearer-only owner writes to a separately enrolled owner key when a phone key lifecycle exists; 2.5 deliberately adds no owner-key registration, rotation or recovery machinery
